snippet.title: Boba Quest Official Kickstarter Trailer
snippet.description:
Boba Quest Trailer is live on Kickstarter! This is our official trailer, we are so exited to share this with you. Thank you for all of your continued support.
Make sure to check out our Kickstarter for early bird rewards and to get your copy of the alpha!🎉🫶🏻
